explanation: The theorem says the library's own canonical comparison map is an isomorphism. The map is the mate of the forgotten additive unit. It compares the Type-valued sheaf pullback of the underlying sheaf with the underlying sheaf of the AddCommGrp pullback. The library's proof rewrites it to a hand-built inverse. I searched Mathlib/Topology/Sheaves, in particular Functors.lean, and grepped for preservesPullback. I found no statement that the sheaf pullback commutes with the forgetful functor for abelian group sheaves. The only nearby hit was a pullback-versus-presheaf-pullback isomorphism in Functors.lean, which says something different.
